module: Telemetry tracker for small gameplay features that do not have their own tracker: the track builder (activity "trackBuilder") and the taxi (event "taxiCalled" and activity "taxiRide"). The duration of a session or a ride is carried by the activity.
notes: The track builder window sends all openings/closings through a single call, which also repeats the current state: the activity is therefore matched on the tracker's internal state, not on each call.
onExit and onExtensionUnloaded (same function) close both activities; an interrupted taxi ride is ended with reason = "gameExit".
Taxi ride outcomes (onTaxiRideEnded): reason is exited or trafficStopped; phase indicates where the ride was (arriving = the taxi had stopped for the player); distances are in meters.

onTrackBuilderWindowToggled.desc: Hook called when the track builder window opens/closes: starts or ends the trackBuilder activity (with the current level).

open.desc: true if the window is open.

onTaxiCalled.desc: Hook called when the player calls a taxi: emits taxiCalled with the result.

onTaxiRideStarted.desc: Hook called at the start of a ride: starts the taxiRide activity (called or not, career mode or not, level).

called.desc: false for a taxi hailed at the roadside.

onTaxiRideEnded.desc: Hook called at the end of a ride: ends the taxiRide activity with the received data.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: manual unload.

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game closes: closes the open activities.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: a Lua reload destroys the trackers without onExit, so the activities are also closed here.
